reason: Python's argparse took prog from the invoked script (tools/<tool>.py); the Go binaries are run as their installed command (tools/install.sh), so usage and help name that command, not a retired .py script.
stdout:
usage: modfind [root] slots [-h] [--json] [--csv] [--limit N] [--type TYPE]
                            [--flags FLAGS] [--name NAME]

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --json         machine JSON output
  --csv          CSV output (header + rows)
  --limit, -n N  print at most N rows (default: all); the cut is reported
  --type TYPE    substring of the slot type
  --flags FLAGS  require these flags (o/s/h/r/t or OPERATOR..)
  --name NAME    regex on slot name
